newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan stocks close barely moved.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan stocks close barely moved.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks closed barely moved on Tuesday with sellers holding out expecting the market to go up, brokers said.
"The index is stagnating. Sellers are not ready to pass on shares at these levels, expecting the market to go up," said Shanil Perera at Lanka Securities.

The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) all share price index was just 0.7 points down at 726.8 on turnover of 39 million rupees, boosted by 42,900 Development Finance, which closed three rupees up at 273 rupees.
Prasanna Chandrasekera, a trader specialising in retail investors at brokerage John Keells, said he expects the market to rise steadily on good first quarter results coming out now.
"Sellers are holding out on companies that are doing well and waiting for their prices to go up," he said.
Shares of privatised plantation firms to be sold on the stock exchange shortly should also boost interest, he said.

A parcel of 2.19 million shares of Lanka Ceramic Ltd, introduced on an all-or-none basis at 40 rupees each will stay on bid for three days in line with CSE rules governing the sale of five percent or more of a firm's issued capital.
